dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Sharp, linear 2D narrowing of the visible torso from the mid-section toward a posterior vertex.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Medium slate-grey median pixel intensity across the visible dorsal area.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse dark-grey patches visible bilaterally along the lateral flanks.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradients between the primary grey pigment and the slightly lighter central dorsal midline.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A prominent, high-contrast white linear mark oriented longitudinally along the central dorsal axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive longitudinal white scar or scrape following the sagittal plane of the visible dorsal surface.
